description: Backend for Absen Masuk: add 'staff' role + jabatan column, create staff_attendance_schedules and staff_attendances tables, add the two models, extend User and SystemSetting, implement StaffAttendanceController (check-in with GPS Haversine + SchoolNetworkSetting IP fallback, today status, history, admin rekap, CSV export, settings get/set), and register all routes in api.php. This is the foundation the frontend (FEAT-002) depends on — it defines the full API contract.
steps: Create backend/database/migrations/2026_10_01_000001_add_staff_role_and_jabatan_to_users.php as an anonymous Migration class. Add `private function supportsAlterModify(): bool { return in_array(DB::connection()->getDriverName(), ['mysql','mariadb'], true); }`. up(): `if ($this->supportsAlterModify() && Schema::hasColumn('users','role')) { DB::statement("ALTER TABLE users MODIFY COLUMN role ENUM('admin','guru','siswa','staff') DEFAULT 'siswa'"); }` then `Schema::table('users', function (Blueprint $t) { if (!Schema::hasColumn('users','jabatan')) { $t->string('jabatan',100)->nullable()->after('nip'); } });`. down(): revert ENUM to ENUM('admin','guru','siswa') DEFAULT 'siswa' (same guard) and `if (Schema::hasColumn('users','jabatan')) Schema::table('users', fn(Blueprint $t)=>$t->dropColumn('jabatan'));`. Imports: use Illuminate\Database\Migrations\Migration; use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint; use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema; use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

Create backend/app/Models/StaffAttendance.php. `class StaffAttendance extends Model { use HasFactory; protected $fillable = ['user_id','date','checked_in_at','latitude','longitude','ip_address','location_method','is_location_valid','distance_meters','device_id','notes']; protected function casts(): array { return ['date'=>'date','checked_in_at'=>'datetime','is_location_valid'=>'boolean']; } public function user() { return $this->belongsTo(User::class); } }`.

Create backend/app/Models/StaffAttendanceSchedule.php. `class StaffAttendanceSchedule extends Model { use HasFactory; protected $fillable = ['name','work_days','check_in_start','check_in_end','is_default']; protected function casts(): array { return ['work_days'=>'array','is_default'=>'boolean']; } }`.

Modify backend/app/Models/User.php: add 'jabatan' to the protected $fillable array; add `public function isStaff(): bool { return $this->role === 'staff'; }` next to isSiswa(); add `public function staffAttendances() { return $this->hasMany(StaffAttendance::class); }` next to the existing attendances() relation. Do not modify any existing method.

Modify backend/app/Models/SystemSetting.php: add the five constants SCHOOL_LATITUDE_KEY='school_latitude', SCHOOL_LONGITUDE_KEY='school_longitude', STAFF_ATTENDANCE_RADIUS_KEY='staff_attendance_radius_meters', STAFF_CHECKIN_START_KEY='staff_attendance_check_in_start', STAFF_CHECKIN_END_KEY='staff_attendance_check_in_end'. Add static methods matching the existing Cache::rememberForever (try/catch fail-safe) + updateOrCreate/Cache::forever pattern: getSchoolCoordinates():array (reads each key, casts to float or null), setSchoolCoordinates(?float $lat, ?float $lng):void, getStaffAttendanceRadius():int (default 100 when unset/invalid), setStaffAttendanceRadius(int $meters):void, getStaffCheckInWindow():array (['start'=>string|null,'end'=>string|null]), setStaffAttendanceSettings(array $data):void (combined setter accepting keys school_latitude, school_longitude, radius_meters, check_in_start, check_in_end; calls the individual setters and flushes the affected Cache::forget(cacheKey(...)) entries). Do not remove existing constants/methods.

Create backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/StaffAttendanceController.php extending App\Http\Controllers\Controller. Implement per the location-validation rules below: checkIn(Request) (validate latitude nullable|numeric, longitude nullable|numeric, device_id nullable|string, notes nullable|string; reject 422 if already checked in today via StaffAttendance::where('user_id',$user->id)->whereDate('date',today())->exists(); read SystemSetting::getStaffCheckInWindow() and skip the window check if either start/end is null/empty, else compare Carbon::now() against the inclusive [start,end] and reject 422 outside; get client IP via private getRealClientIp(Request) copied from AttendanceController; if lat&&lng present -> location_method='gps', if school coords null skip validation is_location_valid=true distance_meters=null else haversineDistance() and is_location_valid = distance <= getStaffAttendanceRadius(); else location_method='network' and is_location_valid = SchoolNetworkSetting::isSchoolNetwork($ip), distance_meters=null; StaffAttendance::create([...]); return success + data checked_in_at,location_method,is_location_valid,distance_meters), private haversineDistance(float $lat1,float $lon1,float $lat2,float $lon2):float (standard formula, meters), private getRealClientIp(Request):string (X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP fallback copied from AttendanceController), todayStatus(Request), myHistory(Request) (paginate 30), adminIndex(Request) (admin-only 403 guard; filters date default today, role guru|staff|all; query User::whereIn('role',['guru','staff']) select id,name,nip,jabatan,role leftJoin staff_attendances on date; map to {nama,nip,jabatan,role,checked_in_at|null,location_method|null,is_location_valid}; summary total/sudah_absen/belum_absen), adminExportCsv(Request) (admin-only, same filters, Symfony StreamedResponse, Content-Type text/csv, Content-Disposition attachment, prepend UTF-8 BOM \xEF\xBB\xBF, columns No/Nama/NIP/Jabatan/Role/Tanggal/Jam Masuk/Metode Lokasi/Status with Status=Hadir|Belum Absen), getSettings(Request), updateSettings(Request) (validate school_latitude nullable|numeric, school_longitude nullable|numeric, radius_meters integer|min:50|max:5000, check_in_start date_format:H:i, check_in_end date_format:H:i; call SystemSetting::setStaffAttendanceSettings; flush caches).

Modify backend/routes/api.php: add `use App\Http\Controllers\Api\StaffAttendanceController;` among the top use statements. Immediately after the // TEACHER (GURU) ROUTES block (before the STUDENT block), add: `Route::middleware('role:guru,staff,admin')->group(function () { Route::post('/staff-attendance/check-in', [StaffAttendanceController::class,'checkIn']); Route::get('/staff-attendance/today', [StaffAttendanceController::class,'todayStatus']); Route::get('/staff-attendance/history', [StaffAttendanceController::class,'myHistory']); });` and `Route::middleware('role:admin')->group(function () { Route::get('/staff-attendance/export', [StaffAttendanceController::class,'adminExportCsv']); Route::get('/staff-attendance/settings', [StaffAttendanceController::class,'getSettings']); Route::post('/staff-attendance/settings', [StaffAttendanceController::class,'updateSettings']); Route::get('/staff-attendance', [StaffAttendanceController::class,'adminIndex']); });` (literal routes before the index route, per repo convention).
acceptance_criteria: All three new migrations are idempotent: running `php artisan migrate` twice applies cleanly and the ENUM ALTER + column-add guards prevent duplicate operations.
`php -l` reports no syntax error for every new/modified PHP file (3 migrations, 2 new models, StaffAttendanceController, User.php, SystemSetting.php, routes/api.php).
`php artisan test` passes the existing suite with no regressions (existing AttendanceController logic and student attendance are untouched).
`php artisan route:list --path=staff-attendance` shows all 7 routes with correct middleware (self group role:guru,staff,admin; admin group role:admin).

checkIn() skips location validation when school coordinates are null (returns is_location_valid=true) and skips the time window when check-in window is null/empty — never blocks an unconfigured check-in.
adminIndex/adminExportCsv reject non-admin users with 403; export CSV begins with the UTF-8 BOM.
verification: From backend/: `php -l app/Models/StaffAttendance.php` and `php -l app/Models/StaffAttendanceSchedule.php` and `php -l app/Models/User.php` and `php -l app/Models/SystemSetting.php` and `php -l routes/api.php` and `php -l` on each new migration file
From backend/: `php artisan route:list --path=staff-attendance` (7 routes, correct middleware)
From backend/: `php artisan test` (existing suite passes, no regression)
